summary: Evaluates the Multicast extensions to OSPF (MOSPF) against the criteria the IETF set for routing protocols in RFC 1264. It reports on the protocol's design and on early implementation and deployment experience. It is informational and does not define a standard.

eli5.summary: A teacher grades a new game against a checklist of rules. This paper checks one network delivery method against the list and writes down what worked.

questions: does mospf meet routing protocol criteria
